title: Windows cmd.exe UTF-8 fix, modular cvh-dev rules (progressive disclosure), rich developer fallback persona, and Backlog-to-Ready Invariant enforcement
commitMessage: feat(agent): fix Windows cmd UTF-8, modular cvh-dev rules, developer fallback, and enforce backlog-to-ready invariant
author: tauri-rust-engineer / agent-developer
summary: Eliminated Windows cmd.exe CP866 black diamonds by prepending 'chcp 65001 >nul && ' in run_scoped_command. Implemented modular progressive-disclosure rules for cvh-dev (.cvh/agents/cvh-dev/rules/boards.md, agents.md, hooks.md) and seeded them in project scaffolding. Added rich BUILTIN_DEVELOPER_PROMPT fallback for the developer role. Enforced strict directory-only agent persona architecture (.cvh/agents/<role>/persona.md) with real disk listing via new list_cortex_agent_files IPC command. Enforced Backlog-to-Ready Invariant across all boards and pipeline configurations (backlog at index 0, ready with terminal:true at final index, auto-re-injecting and forbidding deletion).
